name: play_event_sound

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_PlayEventSound consumes a sound index and two volume percentages, resolves the indexed entry from the active event-sound resource, and divides both volume values by 100 before starting playback

notes: When event sound is enabled, ScriptCommand_PlayEventSound resolves the indexed sound data through D_003D56A8 and invokes the sound playback wrapper with independently scaled left and right levels. It then advances the Script after a fixed four-tick wait. All 91 JP calls pass equal left and right levels; 90 pass 100 percent.
